messages:
IncidentBot: ALERT: garnet-prod (customer:garnet-inc) elevated 5xx rate and p95 response > 2.5s on dedicated-vpc-3 (pool:garnet-dedicated) — pager: @sara_oncall @matt_runtime #severity:page :rotating_light:

sara_oncall: I got the page, seeing the same in the dashboard. p95 jumped ~3.2s starting 00:02 UTC, 5xx spike ~4% of requests.

matt_runtime: copying. stacks show longer KV cache miss rate, contention on stream shards. Possibly model memory eviction thrash.

jess_support: just pulled customer convo — they see errors in chat flow and some order submits failing. Tina is on the phone with their SRE.

tina_csm: confirming customer impact: live checkout failing intermittently for ~10% of users in EU region. They're asking for immediate mitigation and a rollback to previous model if possible.

sara_oncall: ok priority: isolate tenant, reduce load on garnet-dedicated, and prefer safe variant. Options: 1) pin tenant to model v1.4.2 (known stable) 2) route to safe-variant-quantized with lower mem footprint 3) enact temporary per-tenant rate-limits. Thoughts?

matt_runtime: quick check: current live model is v1.5.0-optim. There were kernel changes last week that increase KV footprint. Safe variant v1.4.2-quant has smaller KV and has been stable. Routing change is fast, pin is safe.

raj_infra: we can flip routing policy for that tenant in ~30s using the admin routing API: `POST /route/update` with `routing_policy: { tenant: "garnet-inc", action: "pin", model: "v1.4.2-quant" }`. But need approval from product/CS for customer-visible change.

sara_oncall: Tina — approve putting them on v1.4.2-quant now? It's safe/compatible with their payloads.

tina_csm: Approved. They want stability over throughput. Do not increase cost beyond current committed pool. They asked we avoid any global rollback that affects other tenants.

matt_runtime: doing a staged pin + canary: will pin 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with 2-min windows and health checks. If errors drop we continue. Executing now.

IncidentBot: ACTION: routing update submitted by matt_runtime. Request ID: r-783412. Canary 5% started at 00:08 UTC.

matt_runtime: Canary results: 5% good (errors down to 0.8%), p95 at 1.4s. Proceeding to 25%.

IncidentBot: Canary 25% started at 00:11 UTC.

matt_runtime: 25% looks stable. p95 1.3s, 5xx <1%. Moving to 100% after one more check.

jess_support: I'm drafting the customer update: "We routed your traffic to a known stable variant (v1.4.2-quant). We're monitoring and will confirm when all traffic is on the safe variant." Tina want me to include ETA?

tina_csm: please include: "ETA full switch within 10 minutes; no data loss expected; we'll follow up with root cause."

matt_runtime: 100% switched at 00:18 UTC. Observability: p95 1.25s, 5xx ~0.3%. KV miss/eviction rate falling.

sara_oncall: Excellent. Next: we should schedule a short maintenance window to repro on staging with v1.5.0-optim + debug kernel flags. Also file a ticket with model-onboard team to revert the kernel heuristics causing memory pressure.

raj_infra: Created infra ticket INF-4920 to add per-tenant eviction thresholds and safer fallback policy. Prioritize for next patch.

matt_runtime: Added a temporary per-tenant rate-limit rule to limit burst concurrency to current SLA, to be removed once we confirm stability. Rule ID: rl-12904.

IncidentBot: NOTE: Incident duration 16m so far. Pagerduty: acknowledged.

sara_oncall: handing off to night oncall @raj_infra in 30m. I'll remain available if escalation.

raj_infra: I'll take the handoff. Summary for night: Garnet had model memory thrash on v1.5.0-optim, we pinned them to v1.4.2-quant (safe variant) via routing API, canary to 100% succeeded. Monitor p95 and eviction rate, RL rule rl-12904 in place. Follow the runbook: `docs/runbooks/tenant-fallback.md` and escalate to runtime if p95 rises >2s for >5m.

jess_support: customer notified at 00:22 UTC. They replied: "thanks, stable now, please let us know root cause."

tina_csm: closing immediate incident with customer for now. Follow-up: schedule postmortem, include evals comparing v1.4.2-quant vs v1.5.0-optim on KV footprint and latency under realistic session lengths.

sara_oncall: I'll open incident ticket INC-2026, assign to matt_runtime + model-onboard. Include logs: `link:/observability/garnet/3832100000/trace` and perf snapshot.

matt_runtime: noted. I'll also export the canary perf traces and config diffs.

IncidentBot: RESOLVE: paging window ended, no active page. If any regressions occur reopen with `#page` or `@oncall` mention.

raj_infra: handoff complete. Leaving runbook notes in the ticket. Good job team :thumbsup:
